description: The letter was initiated by former Australia captain Greg Chappell. It is the second appeal by former international captains seeking humane treatment and medical care for the 73-year-old Khan.
title: What’s in the Imran Khan letter? Gavaskar, Kapil make three requests to Pakistan PM

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Anish Peri has pioneered a groundbreaking system that traces the origins of wildfires by analyzing smoke patterns. His innovative project utilizes inverse atmospheric dispersion modeling in conjunction with gas sensor networks to effectively locate fire sources. The significance of his research has earned him distinguished awards in the fields of science and meteorology, highlighting advancements in our understanding of Earth's complex atmospheric dynamics.
title: Meet Anish Peri, the student tracing wildfires back to their source

author: KARAN MANRAL
title: Nevada wildfire: 90,000 people face evacuation as state of emergency declared

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: In the lead-up to impending US sanctions on Iran, oil prices fell as investors capitalized on recent gains. As Washington prepares to unveil its most stringent measures Monday, the potential for disruptions in Middle Eastern oil supply looms large. Iran's rejection of these sanctions, coupled with its threat to cut oil exports from the Gulf, adds a layer of uncertainty to global energy markets that stakeholders are closely monitoring.
title: Oil prices slip over $1 as US weighs ‘D-Day’ Iran sanctions

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: In August 2022, Travis Kelce shared a powerful message about men’s mental health during Chiefs training camp in St. Joseph, Missouri. He stressed that men should feel comfortable expressing their emotions and being vulnerable with trusted people. Kelce connected openness with brotherhood, mentorship and strong teamwork. His words challenged the idea that vulnerability is weakness, offering an important reminder that emotional honesty can strengthen relationships and leadership.
title: Travis Kelce sends powerful mental health message, urges men to speak up

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Telugu superstar Chiranjeevi marked his 71st birthday by highlighting his unwavering commitment to fitness. His demanding workout routine integrates weight training and conditioning, essential for his challenging roles. Medical professionals stress that staying active and retaining muscle strength is crucial after sixty. Fellow actors commend Chiranjeevi's remarkable discipline and enthusiasm for fitness as he gears up for the much-anticipated action film 'Kaaka', set to release in 2027.
title: Chiranjeevi's fitness routine at 71, includes strength training and rope drills

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Yann LeCun desires AI models to perform physical tasks beyond writing essays. He aims to develop methods for AI to learn physical actions efficiently like humans. LeCun also disagrees with definitions of world models and VLMs used in robotics. He previously served as Meta's Chief AI Scientist for seven years. LeCun announced his departure from Meta after twelve years of service.
title: AI ‘Godfather’ Yann LeCun wants AI to solve his ‘bedroom problem’

author: TNN
description: Chennai police are searching various Odisha locations for a couple.  They are suspected of murdering a Jagatsinghpur woman and disposing of her remains.  The victim's body parts were found in a suitcase aboard the Tamil Nadu Express.  Investigators identified the suspects from CCTV footage boarding the train with the bag.  The couple's rented home in Chennai yielded additional body parts during a search.
title: Red suitcase on train, body parts, CCTV clue: How cops traced Chennai woman's killers

author: JASKARAN SINGH
description: A 40-year-old man was allegedly killed by his wife in a knife attack. The woman then jumped from the rooftop and sustained injuries. Police recovered three knives and collected forensic evidence from the scene. The deceased suffered severe abdominal injuries, with organs protruding from his body. The wife is in custody and receiving treatment for her injuries.
title: Woman stabs husband, tries to bag his intestines, jumps off roof as landlord walks in

author: DWAIPAYAN DATTA AND ARANI BASU
description: The significance of the Duleep Trophy is under scrutiny following the ousting of national selectors from the team selection process. Delhi opener Sanat Sangwan faced a surprising benching despite impressive performances in the Ranji Trophy. Former selectors emphasise the need for their participation to ensure equitable player development and mitigate political influences.
title: Duleep Trophy starts with a question mark on relevance

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: In a recent development, New York City's Finance Commissioner delivered a memo about the pied-à-terre tax that he could not present in person due to ongoing litigation. The memo specifies that the supplemental roll does not automatically create tax liabilities for property owners. To evade the surcharge, homeowners are encouraged to provide evidence of their primary residency. Notably, the deadline for lodging appeals has been broadened until September 18, 2026.
title: Mamdani’s team sends memo to ‘upset’ New Yorkers over million-dollar home tax

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: The United States is gearing up for an extensive financial campaign aimed at Iran, introducing new sanctions against nations and companies engaging in trade with Tehran. In response, Iran has signaled a potential halt to oil exports from the Persian Gulf. Meanwhile, China has resisted US influence and advocates for diplomatic efforts. While attempts to rekindle negotiations are underway, the prevailing tensions pose significant challenges.
title: ‘Economic D-Day’: US ‘enters endgame’ against Iran; Tehran threatens Gulf oil blockade

author: SHREEDHAR RATHI
description: Three newborns died after a fire broke out in Amravati District Women's Hospital's NICU. The blaze reportedly started following an explosion in a ventilator on the hospital's third floor. Doctors and staff quickly evacuated thirty-nine newborns from the intensive care unit. Six critically ill infants were transferred to a super-speciality hospital for care. The exact cause of the ventilator explosion and subsequent fire is still under investigation.
title: 3 newborns die after fire breaks out at Amravati hospital NICU

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Awarapan 2 is enjoying an impressive box office journey, surpassing the Rs 136 crore net mark in India. The film made a strong opening with Rs 22 crore and achieved a remarkable first-week collection of Rs 113.50 crore. Following a successful second weekend, its domestic net collection grew to Rs 127.50 crore and the worldwide gross soared to Rs 193.00 crore.
title: 'Awarapan 2' box office day 10: Emraan's film declared hit with 202% profit

author: SARFARAZ AHMED
title: Chlorine leak from tanker leaves several ill in Nagpur's Godni

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Max Verstappen's Dutch Grand Prix ended early after a first-lap crash on a damp track.  Lando Norris capitalised on the chaos, securing a crucial victory for his title hopes.  Norris made a daring overtake to take the lead and hold it until the finish.  Kimi Antonelli finished second, with George Russell completing the podium.  The Dutch Grand Prix is departing the Formula 1 calendar after this season.
title: Watch: Max Verstappen’s horrific Dutch GP crash as Lando Norris wins chaotic race

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Will not compromise national interest for PM's India visit: Bangladesh

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Yashasvi Jaiswal has come under fire for his altercation with Sri Lanka's Asitha Fernando. Former cricketer Ajay Jadeja cautioned Jaiswal about the potential repercussions of his aggressive behaviour. India’s batting coach acknowledged that Jaiswal should have avoided such a heated moment. The incident risks evaluation under the ICC Code of Conduct, with match officials now deliberating on possible sanctions for the young star.
title: ‘If you can’t take it back, don’t say it’: Jadeja’s blunt message to Jaiswal

author: TNN
description: An out-of-control car crashed through a divider at Delhi's ITO on Sunday evening. The vehicle then collided head-on with an SUV carrying two Members of the Legislative Assembly. Anil Jha and Abhay Patil sustained minor injuries in the accident near the PWD office. Both MLAs were promptly shifted to LNJP Hospital for medical observation. The collision caused significant damage and required the Fire Brigade's assistance.
title: 2 Delhi MLAs among several injured after car jumps divider, slams into SUV

author: CHETHAN KUMAR
title: Scientists stuck in red tape and admin work: Niti Aayog report

author: NAVJEEVAN GOPAL
title: SIR ordeal: ‘Was envoy for India in 3 countries, but tough to prove citizenship’

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A remarkable endeavor has come to fruition with over 300 artistically crafted reef modules now anchored in the depths off South Florida. This seven-year journey melds art with conservation, creating artificial habitats from sustainable concrete that nurture marine species. Supported by local governments, this innovative project aims to enhance tourism while safeguarding natural ecosystems, with aspirations for international expansion in attracting marine life.
title: From 2019 to now: 300 mermaid sculptures turn Florida seabed into reef

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: An ambitious English businessman has reimagined a historic Scottish hunting estate as a lush wilderness reserve. His initiative, which includes the planting of over one million native trees, has revived populations of red squirrels in the glens. The project also emphasizes the restoration of peatlands and the breeding of Scottish wildcats, with funding from upscale eco-tourism driving significant conservation efforts to protect and restore local ecosystems for the future.
title: After 20 years and 1 million trees, red squirrels return to rewilded Scottish estate

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In Kennington, a neglected Victorian water tower dating back to 1877 has been transformed into a stunning family residence. This Grade II-listed landmark, originally built for an asylum, underwent a lavish restoration by a British couple. They incorporated a contemporary glass cube and an additional utility tower, resulting in a remarkable home boasting four bedrooms and panoramic views of the city.
title: British couple turns derelict 85-foot Victorian water tower into family home
